terminology.lifeRuntimeRepresentation: Removing one Wound recovers one Life in the campaign health model.

firewoodUse.rule: One supplied Firewood token permits one Rest; completing that Rest discards one Firewood token.

sessionBudget.rule: The current Quest card supplies the Resting Point amount available to the party for the Rest.

restingPointAllocation.rule: Players collectively choose the Hero allocation; the engine must not choose targets or recovery resources.

pointConversion.rule: Each point spent recovers exactly 1 Life or exactly 1 Stress.

multiplePointsPerHero.rule: A Hero may receive multiple points and chooses how to spend that Hero's allocation.

onePurposePerPoint.rule: A point recovers Life or Stress, never both.

budgetConsumption.rule: A Rest must spend the entire Resting Point amount supplied by the Quest.

partialSpend.rule: Players may not voluntarily complete Rest after spending only part of a positive printed budget.

zeroPointRest.rule: A zero-point allocation cannot complete a Rest whose printed budget is positive.
zeroPointRest.derivation: Zero spent points cannot equal the explicitly required full positive budget.

insufficientRecoveryCapacity.blocker: Sources do not say whether excess points may be spent without recovery effect or whether Rest is unavailable.

roomGate.rule: Rest is legal only in a cleared Room.

recoveryCap.rule: A recovery allocation cannot exceed the target Hero's current missing Life or current Stress.
